newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Xinjiang separatists plant Beijing bomb -agency.
newsitem.headline: Xinjiang separatists plant Beijing bomb -agency.

text.p: A dissidents group from China's restive Xinjiang region said Friday's bomb attack in Beijing was carried out by ethnic Uighur separatists exiled in Kazakhstan, Taiwan's state-run news agency reported on Sunday.

"The bus explosion in Beijing city...is the only way for the Xinjiang Uighur people to take revenge against communist China's oppression," state-run Central News Agency quoted a statement from the Turkey-based Organisation for Turkestan Freedom as saying.
The statement said the explosion, which ripped through a rush-hour bus on Friday, killed three people and injured 10. Beijing has said no one was killed.

It said the ethnic Uighur separatists who carried out the attack were from Xinjiang. The Uighur group vowed to stage more attacks. "Similar bomb incidences will continue until Xinjiang achieves complete freedom," it said.
Friday's bombing followed similar attacks in far-western Xinjiang where separatists have been active. A recent spate of bus bombings in the largely Moslem region killed nine people and wounded 74.
